description: Total duration of SPK segments attributed to this participant.
Fraction of task duration this participant was speaking (SPK time / task duration).
Number of SPK annotation segments for this participant.
Mean duration of this participant's SPK segments.
Median duration of this participant's SPK segments.
Standard deviation of this participant's SPK segment durations.
Mean gap_prev_ms for SPK rows where gap > 0 ms; reflects how long this participant waits before taking a turn.
Mean trp_silence_ms for SPK rows where TRP silence > 0; silence held at a transition-relevance place before speaking.
Total time (from overlap_ms column) this participant's speech overlapped with someone else.
Ratio of overlap_time_s to speaking_time_s.
Number of SPK rows with interruption_gap_ms < 0 (this participant was interrupted or started while someone else spoke).
interruption_count divided by task duration in minutes.
Number of BCK rows produced by this participant (e.g. mm-hmm, yeah, uh-huh while another speaks).
backchannel_given_count divided by task duration in minutes.
Mean bclatency_ms for this participant's BCK rows; how quickly they react with a backchannel after the main speaker's onset.
Number of FP (filled pause, e.g. um, uh) rows for this participant.
filled_pause_count divided by task duration in minutes.
Number of BRE (audible breath) rows for this participant.
Estimated task duration (max offset − min onset across all rows).
Number of P1–P4 participants who produced at least one SPK segment.
Sum of SPK segment counts across all active participants.
Total duration of GROUP SIL rows (annotated group silences).
sil_time_s divided by task_duration_s.
Number of GROUP SIL annotation rows.
Number of GROUP LAU (laughter) events.
Total duration of GROUP LAU events.
Number of GROUP OVL (overlap) annotation rows.
OVL rows with subtype 'competitive' or 'floor_fight' (speakers competing for the floor).
OVL rows with cooperative subtypes: collaborative, smooth, simultaneous, or backchannel_ovl.
OVL rows with subtype 'collaborative'.
OVL rows with subtype 'needs_review' (ambiguous intent, requires manual review).
competitive_overlap_count / (competitive_overlap_count + cooperative_overlap_count).
OVL rows with subtype 'simultaneous' (parallel speech without floor contest).
OVL rows with subtype 'backchannel_ovl' (overlap caused by a backchannel during main speech).
Shannon entropy of the inter-speaker turn-transition matrix. Higher values indicate more evenly distributed floor exchanges.
Gini coefficient of speaking_time_s across active participants. 0 = perfect equality; 1 = one participant speaks all the time.
Total non-SIL annotation rows divided by task duration in minutes; proxy for overall interaction density.
